Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

Senior Deployment Engineer - LLM Inference & Optimization

About The Role

We’re looking for a Deployment Engineer who combines hands-on AI engineering, model optimization, and strong customer-facing skills.

You’ll work directly with customers to bring AI models and applications into production, improve their performance, and integrate them with enterprise systems. You’ll own technical delivery from discovery and benchmarking through deployment and adoption, working closely with customer stakeholders and our product and engineering teams.

This role requires someone who enjoys writing code, experimenting with models, diagnosing performance bottlenecks, and helping customers achieve measurable improvements in model quality, latency, throughput, and cost.

What You’ll Do

Understand customer requirements: Lead technical discovery to define use cases, workloads, infrastructure constraints, and targets for model quality, latency, throughput, and cost.
Optimize inference: Apply techniques such as quantization, batching, prefix caching, KV-cache optimization, and parallelism to improve performance while preserving output quality.
Adapt models to customer needs: Improve results through prompt optimization, retrieval-augmented generation, and fine-tuning where appropriate. Evaluate the impact of each approach.
Troubleshoot performance: Investigate issues across model execution, GPU utilization, memory consumption, serving infrastructure, and application behavior.
Lead technical customer engagement: Run workshops, present benchmark findings, explain tradeoffs, and guide customers through deployment and optimization decisions.
Build reusable capabilities: Create evaluation tools, benchmark harnesses, deployment configurations, and runbooks. Bring recurring customer needs and performance findings back to product and engineering.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of experience in software engineering, ML engineering, AI infrastructure, or a related hands-on technical role.
Strong Python programming skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, or comparable tools.
Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing AI models in production, particularly LLMs.
Experience with model-serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or similar technologies.
An understanding of GPU memory constraints, numerical precision, batching, caching, and parallelism, including how these affect inference performance.
Experience building evaluations and benchmarks to measure model quality, latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.
Experience developing APIs and integrating model endpoints with production applications and customer data systems.
Familiarity with GPU-based cloud environments, containers, and monitoring tools used to operate model deployments.
The ability to work directly with customers, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly, and translate business requirements into measurable engineering targets.
Strong ownership and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to move from an ambiguous problem to a tested solution.

Nice to have

Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA.
Experience with speculative decoding, multi-GPU inference, or distributed model serving.
Experience profiling GPU workloads using CUDA, NVIDIA Nsight, or related tools.
Experience optimizing embedding models, rerankers, vision models, or multimodal systems.
Experience improving retrieval quality and evaluating end-to-end RAG applications.
Contributions to open-source model-serving, optimization, or evaluation projects.
Experience delivering enterprise AI implementations or customer-facing technical engagements.

What Success Looks Like

You help customers deploy AI solutions that meet agreed quality and performance targets. Your work produces measurable improvements in latency, throughput, GPU utilization, and cost while maintaining model quality. Customers understand the tradeoffs, trust your technical guidance, and can operate the solutions you deliver. Your findings and tools make future deployments faster and more effective.

Senior Deployment Engineer - LLM Inference & Optimization

About The Role

We’re looking for a Deployment Engineer who combines hands-on AI engineering, model optimization, and strong customer-facing skills.

You’ll work directly with customers to bring AI models and applications into production, improve their performance, and integrate them with enterprise systems. You’ll own technical delivery from discovery and benchmarking through deployment and adoption, working closely with customer stakeholders and our product and engineering teams.

This role requires someone who enjoys writing code, experimenting with models, diagnosing performance bottlenecks, and helping customers achieve measurable improvements in model quality, latency, throughput, and cost.

Understand customer requirements: Lead technical discovery to define use cases, workloads, infrastructure constraints, and targets for model quality, latency, throughput, and cost.
Optimize inference: Apply techniques such as quantization, batching, prefix caching, KV-cache optimization, and parallelism to improve performance while preserving output quality.
Adapt models to customer needs: Improve results through prompt optimization, retrieval-augmented generation, and fine-tuning where appropriate. Evaluate the impact of each approach.
Troubleshoot performance: Investigate issues across model execution, GPU utilization, memory consumption, serving infrastructure, and application behavior.
Lead technical customer engagement: Run workshops, present benchmark findings, explain tradeoffs, and guide customers through deployment and optimization decisions.
Build reusable capabilities: Create evaluation tools, benchmark harnesses, deployment configurations, and runbooks. Bring recurring customer needs and performance findings back to product and engineering.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years of experience in software engineering, ML engineering, AI infrastructure, or a related hands-on technical role.
Strong Python programming skills and experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, or comparable tools.
Hands-on experience deploying and optimizing AI models in production, particularly LLMs.
Experience with model-serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or similar technologies.
An understanding of GPU memory constraints, numerical precision, batching, caching, and parallelism, including how these affect inference performance.
Experience building evaluations and benchmarks to measure model quality, latency, throughput, and resource efficiency.
Experience developing APIs and integrating model endpoints with production applications and customer data systems.
Familiarity with GPU-based cloud environments, containers, and monitoring tools used to operate model deployments.
The ability to work directly with customers, communicate technical tradeoffs clearly, and translate business requirements into measurable engineering targets.
Strong ownership and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to move from an ambiguous problem to a tested solution.

Nice to have

Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA or QLoRA.
Experience with speculative decoding, multi-GPU inference, or distributed model serving.
Experience profiling GPU workloads using CUDA, NVIDIA Nsight, or related tools.
Experience optimizing embedding models, rerankers, vision models, or multimodal systems.
Experience improving retrieval quality and evaluating end-to-end RAG applications.
Contributions to open-source model-serving, optimization, or evaluation projects.
Experience delivering enterprise AI implementations or customer-facing technical engagements.

You help customers deploy AI solutions that meet agreed quality and performance targets. Your work produces measurable improvements in latency, throughput, GPU utilization, and cost while maintaining model quality. We have an exciting opportunity for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) supporting Seaboard Energy, based out of our Merriam, KS office. Hands-on build (70 to 80% of time)

added.description:
Overview

At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget.

Our Science & Technology directorates include National Security, Earth and Biological Sciences, Physical and Computational Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus.

The National Security Directorate (NSD) drives science-based, mission-focused solutions to take on complex, real-world threats to our nation and the world.

The Nuclear, Chemical, and Biological Technologies Division, within the National Security Directorate, works across fundamental science, research and development, and operations to counter emerging national security threats. We focus on discovering signatures and understanding threats by creating materials, methods, and technologies to detect and analyze them. Our researchers deliver solutions to address complex mission challenges, such as explosives detection, biological threat detection, chemical and nuclear forensics, and special nuclear materials.

Responsibilities

You’ll join the Applied Radiation Detection (ARD) Group
in the Nuclear, Chemical, and Biological Technologies Division of PNNL’s National Security Directorate. Our group brings together expertise in radiation measurements, novel sensors, advanced detection systems, and data analytics to address national and international security challenges.

What You’ll Do

Find meaningful signals in complex data. Develop machine learning methods for radiation detection and characterization, addressing challenges such as low-count measurements, changing backgrounds, and limited labeled data.
Connect algorithms with physics. Work with domain scientists to understand detector responses, measurement conditions, and the physical processes behind the data.
Adapt modern super intelligence to scientific problems. Apply and extend deep learning methods, fine-tune open-source models for computer vision and natural language processing, and develop agentic workflows where they can support research and analysis.
Build useful scientific datasets. Develop labeling strategies, engineer features, and prepare measurement data for reproducible training and evaluation.
Evaluate performance in context. Investigate detection sensitivity, false alarms, uncertainty, and robustness across measurement conditions—not just aggregate model accuracy.
Turn research into working tools. Write Python-based machine learning software and apply software engineering best practices to support reliable analysis and deployment.
Help guide the research. Evaluate current literature, design experiments, and collaborate with a mentor and project teams to set goals and pursue promising directions.
Communicate the science. Explain methods, assumptions, and results through publications, presentations, and collaboration with scientists and engineers.
Build SI Grounded in Science. Join us to advance how we measure, interpret, and detect radiation—and apply that knowledge to consequential challenges in nuclear science and national security.

Bring your curiosity about super intelligence and the physical world. Help turn complex measurements into knowledge that matters!

BS/BA in physics, nuclear engineering, computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related technical field and 2 years of relevant experience -OR-
MS/MA in physics, nuclear engineering, computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related technical field -OR-

A PhD in physics, nuclear engineering, computer science, data science, mathematics, or a related field.
Strong programming skills, particularly in Python; experience with C/C++ is also valuable.
Strong knowledge in at least one of the following: applied machine learning, agentic AI, deep learning, or statistics.
Experience building evaluation datasets, test harnesses, agentic harnesses, automated graders, behavioral tests, or analysis pipelines.
A background in nuclear physics, radiation detection, nuclear measurements, sensor data analysis, or a related scientific field.
Interest in connecting data-driven methods with physical models and domain knowledge.
Experience with deterministic NLP, computer vision, retrieval, search, rules, or classical machine-learning methods that complement generative SI.
A record of clear scientific writing and publication.
Creativity, strong problem-solving skills, and initiative.
The ability to contribute to a collaborative, multidisciplinary team.
Deep expertise in a relevant scientific or technical field, with a desire to grow your capabilities in machine learning and SI.

Not Applicable

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance.

A security clearance background investigation includes review of your employment, education, financial, and criminal history, as well as interviews with you and your personal references, neighbors, and co-workers to determine trustworthiness, reliability, and loyalty to the United States. Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. About Us

Indigo Beam Consulting provides a common-sense approach to solving business problems through technology.

Born out of Bluware Inc. which has been in business for twenty-seven years, Indigo Beam was conceived as a full-service business consulting company that deeply cares about creating technology solutions that are in harmony with the environments in which they exist.

We believe that for a technology solution to be sustainable, it must be congruent with the business processes it serves, indigenously maintainable, and cognizant of the unique traits of the organization which it calls home.

Job Title: Data & AI Solution Architect

Job Category: Software Development/ Engineering

Job Type: Contract

Location: Houston, Texas, United States

Data & AI Solution Architect

Position Description

Description

This is a Solution Architect role with strong Data Architecture experience. It is not a Data Engineer, pure Data Architect or AI Architect role. The successful candidate must be capable of owning the end-to-end solution architecture & artefacts, while also personally developing the solution logical data architecture and guiding the physical data design.

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect to deliver end-to-end architecture for projects within a major energy client, including solutions that enable data, analytics and AI use cases. The architect translates business goals and requirements into fit-for-purpose solution designs that align with business goals, technology direction, enterprise architecture principles and client standards.

The role requires independent delivery of high-quality architecture artefacts, including solution designs, Solution Logical Data Models and, where required, Physical Data Models. The architect evaluates solution options and trade-offs, considering value, affordability, do-ability and absorbability, identifies architecture risks and dependencies, and provides architecture direction and assurance through implementation.

This is primarily an individual contributor role. The architect will work independently on assigned project/solution deliverables, owning the architecture through delivery while working to the direction and priorities set by the Lead Architect.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

Develop and maintain end-to-end solution and data architectures across applications, integrations, AI and data platforms to enable analytics, AI, GenAI and agent-based use cases where required by the business.
Translate business and functional requirements into implementable architecture designs, evaluating solution options, trade-offs, risks and dependencies.
Produce and maintain appropriate solution architecture artefacts, including:
Solution context and architecture overview
Solution/application component architecture and interaction views
Data architecture and data-flow diagrams
Interface, API and integration views
Architecture decisions, risks, assumptions and dependencies
Document and design to non-functional and security requirements

About The Team

The Paid Marketing Analytics team is looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to lead brand analytics at DoorDash. This Data Scientist will partner closely with senior Marketing leaders to define our brand measurement approach and guide our brand investment strategy and decision-making. Data Scientists at DoorDash work to uncover insights and turn them into relevant recommendations, driving decisions for the entire organization. Analytics is integral to all operational areas at DoorDash.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Scientist leading brand analytics, you’ll use your quantitative background in brand analytics to define how we measure the impact of brand investment and how brand health affects our business. You’ll report to the leader of Marketing Analytics, and partner closely with our Brand Marketing team. If you enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, and have experience using brand analytics to affect revenue, growth, and investment, we're looking for someone like you!

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Influence brand strategy, define brand measurement for DoorDash, and play a crucial role in sharing the DoorDash brand externally with our customers.
Partner closely with Marketing leadership to define metrics, KPIs, and a measurement strategy for the DoorDash brand
Work at the intersection of modeling, brand strategy, and business decision making
Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business
Use brand lift survey data, internal metrics, and incrementality testing to create a holistic view of brand impact
Build full-cycle analytics experiments, reports, and dashboards using cutting-edge AI tooling, SQL, R, Python, or other scripting and statistical tools
Be a champion of Brand Analytics within the team and advocate and educate on broader incorporation of leading concepts into Marketing and Consumer plans
Produce recommendations and use statistical techniques and hypothesis testing or causal inference to validate your findings
Provide insights to help business and product leaders understand marketplace dynamics, user behaviors, and long-term trends
Identify and measure levers to help move essential metrics and make recommendations
Work backwards from understanding and sizing problems to ideating solutions

We’re Excited About You Because You Have…

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
5+ years of experience in brand and marketing analytics owning brand measurement at the intersection of modeling, brand strategy, and business decision making
Demonstrated experience leading the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of an end-to-end brand measurement system, including KPI selection and validation, ongoing brand tracking, campaign lift measurement, and integration with MMM and incrementality testing.
Experience leading brand modeling, working directly with clients, and translating the findings into decisions that drive business growth.
Deep understanding of brand marketing and paid media, with a track record of translating measurement findings into decisions about audiences, investment, and channel mix, and evaluating the relationship between brand health and downstream business outcomes.
Understanding of brand health metrics, consumer attitudes, audience strategy, creative effectiveness, and how media channels contribute across the funnel
Experience with marketing and brand measurement, MMM, attribution, incrementality testing, and brand lift surveys
Expertise of SQL queries, ETL, A/B Testing, Causal Inference, survey analytics, and statistical analysis (e.g. hypothesis testing, experimentation, regressions) with statistical packages, such as Matlab, R, SAS or Python
Experience leveraging AI coding tools to improve productivity and harden repeatable processes without sacrificing accuracy or code quality (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor)
The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Introduction to the team

Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction.

The Traveler Discovery & Planning team at Expedia is at the forefront of innovation in AI-driven agentic systems. We're dedicated to enhancing customer experiences, increasing engagement, and strengthening traveler relationships through cutting-edge machine learning solutions. Our work directly impacts millions of travelers worldwide, shaping their journey from dreaming to booking and beyond.

Join a team that’s focused on Agentic Experiences revolutionizing traveler experiences through autonomous, intelligent agent systems. In This Role, You Will

Design, build, and evaluate multi-step agentic AI systems, including autonomous agents capable of planning, tool use, memory management, and multi-agent collaboration
Research and implement state-of-the-art techniques in agentic architectures, such as ReAct, reflection loops, chain-of-thought prompting, and tool-augmented reasoning
Develop and maintain agent orchestration frameworks, defining how agents decompose tasks, delegate to sub-agents, and handle failure and recovery
Integrate large language models (LLMs) with external tools, APIs, databases, and code execution environments to enable real-world task completion
Define and own evaluation frameworks for agentic systems, measuring task success, reliability, latency, cost, and safety across diverse benchmarks and production scenarios
Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and research teams to translate business requirements into agentic system designs and deliver production-grade solutions
Identify and mitigate risks specific to agentic systems, including prompt injection, unintended actions, hallucination in long-horizon tasks, and unsafe tool use

3-5+ years of related industry experience
Demonstrated experience designing and deploying agentic or multi-step AI systems (e.g., ReAct, tool-calling agents, multi-agent pipelines) in production or research settings
Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX); experience with LLM APIs and orchestration libraries (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
Experience integrating LLMs with external tools, APIs, and structured data sources for real-world task completion
Solid understanding of prompt engineering techniques including chain-of-thought, few-shot prompting, and structured output generation
Experience defining and running evaluation frameworks for ML systems, including offline benchmarking and production monitoring

Experience in the travel or e-commerce industry
Publications in top-tier ML conferences or journals
Patented Inventions, pending and issued
Contributions to open-source ML projects
Experience taking models from prototype to production in collaboration with Machine Learning Engineering teams

Data Scientists at DoorDash work to uncover insights and turn them into relevant recommendations, driving decisions for the entire organization. As a Senior Data Scientist leading brand analytics, you’ll use your quantitative background in brand analytics to define how we measure the impact of brand investment and how brand health affects our business. You’ll report to the leader of Marketing Analytics, and partner closely with our Brand Marketing team. If you enjoy finding patterns amidst chaos, and have experience using brand analytics to affect revenue, growth, and investment, we're looking for someone like you!

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…

Influence brand strategy, define brand measurement for DoorDash, and play a crucial role in sharing the DoorDash brand externally with our customers.
Partner closely with Marketing leadership to define metrics, KPIs, and a measurement strategy for the DoorDash brand
Work at the intersection of modeling, brand strategy, and business decision making
Use quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to see beyond the numbers and understand what drives our business

Build full-cycle analytics experiments, reports, and dashboards using cutting-edge AI tooling, SQL, R, Python, or other scripting and statistical tools
Be a champion of Brand Analytics within the team and advocate and educate on broader incorporation of leading concepts into Marketing and Consumer plans
Produce recommendations and use statistical techniques and hypothesis testing or causal inference to validate your findings
Provide insights to help business and product leaders understand marketplace dynamics, user behaviors, and long-term trends
Identify and measure levers to help move essential metrics and make recommendations
Work backwards from understanding and sizing problems to ideating solutions

We’re Excited About You Because You Have…

A degree in Math, Physics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a similar domain
5+ years of experience in brand and marketing analytics owning brand measurement at the intersection of modeling, brand strategy, and business decision making
Demonstrated experience leading the design, implementation, and ongoing operation of an end-to-end brand measurement system, including KPI selection and validation, ongoing brand tracking, campaign lift measurement, and integration with MMM and incrementality testing.
Experience leading brand modeling, working directly with clients, and translating the findings into decisions that drive business growth.
Deep understanding of brand marketing and paid media, with a track record of translating measurement findings into decisions about audiences, investment, and channel mix, and evaluating the relationship between brand health and downstream business outcomes.
Understanding of brand health metrics, consumer attitudes, audience strategy, creative effectiveness, and how media channels contribute across the funnel
Experience with marketing and brand measurement, MMM, attribution, incrementality testing, and brand lift surveys
Expertise of SQL queries, ETL, A/B Testing, Causal Inference, survey analytics, and statistical analysis (e.g. hypothesis testing, experimentation, regressions) with statistical packages, such as Matlab, R, SAS or Python
Experience leveraging AI coding tools to improve productivity and harden repeatable processes without sacrificing accuracy or code quality (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor)
The insight to take ambiguous problems and solve them in a structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported way

As a Data Scientist on the Business Banking Lending Product Analytics team, you'll partner closely with business stakeholders to deliver analytics that senior leaders can act on; turning complex data into clear, confident decisions. You'll partner closely with Lending Strategy and Product leaders to build defensible metrics, run deep-dive analyses, and deliver benchmarking and impactful reporting. This role will require you to be strategy-oriented and focused on performance insights across the lending lifecycle.

You will operate as a trusted analytics partner—framing high-impact business questions, defining measurement approaches, building and validating datasets, and translating complex findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You will use repeatable KPI and reporting frameworks (with strong documentation and controls), deliver benchmarking and peer comparisons where relevant, and help build scalable analytical solutions that improve how we monitor performance and support our customers and bankers.

Your work will drive meaningful business impact by deepening our understanding of customer behavior, identifying growth and experience opportunities, and supporting the ongoing evolution of our lending products—while maintaining strong data quality and governance.

Job Responsibilities

Build strong relationships with Product Managers and functional partners (Operation, Risk, Controls, Finance, Tech).
Execute the analyses and reporting from end to end (problem framing → data sourcing → analysis/modeling → insights → stakeholder review).
Translate complex findings into clear, non-technical summaries and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Think from a business standpoint and connect the “why” to the data, assumptions, and trade-offs.
Maintain KPI logic and documentation to support auditability and consistent measurement.
Identify opportunities to improve measurement, automation, and analytical workflows (including AI-assisted approaches where appropriate).

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or related discipline) and 3+ years of experience in advanced analytics roles.
Strong skills in SQL and modern analytics programming (e.g., Python/R) for data querying, transformation, analysis, and validation.
Proficiency in statistical analysis and product/customer analytics methods (e.g., hypothesis testing, predictive modeling, experimentation/measurement design).
Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations, with clear, executive-ready storytelling.
Effective working cross-functionally in a dynamic product environment, aligning stakeholders and driving decisions.
Competent using AI tools to accelerate insight generation and improve solution quality, applying them responsibly in a regulated environment.
Hands-on experience across data platforms (on-prem and cloud), such as Teradata/Oracle and AWS/Snowflake.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Business Banking lending products and processes is a plus.
Experience with experimentation, forecasting, segmentation, or predictive modeling in a product setting.
Experience working in a regulated environment with risk and controls expectations.
